messages.author: c6de7ff6d6653d42
messages.subject: Problem with lookback
parts:
Hi,

I need help with very basic stuff regarding string manipulation.

I have strings like:

"*PAU: [4] cê sabe aqui como é que [/3] como é que tem que fazer esse
muro aqui / né //"
"*ROG: [12] aqui já tá dando [/4] aqui já tá dando a altura //"
"*ROG: [24] mas <olha [/1] olha> [/1] olha por cima pro sior ver //"

What I need is to insert the tag <r> in every instance of [/n], where
n is a number.

So I used gsub with this regular expression:

"/(\\d)\\]", "/\1\\]<r>"

Problem is, lookback does not retrieve the number between square
brackets. The output is this:

"*PAU: [4] cê sabe aqui como é que [/ #]<r> como é que tem que fazer
esse muro aqui / né //"
"*ROG: [12] aqui já tá dando [/# ]<r> aqui já tá dando a altura //"
"*ROG: [24] mas <olha [/# ]<r> olha> [/ #]<r> olha por cima pro sior
ver //"

Where # is an unidentifiable character.

Any suggestion?

Best regards,
M.

messages.subject: Re: [StatForLing with R] Problem with lookback
parts:
is it a typo that you don't call the backreference with

\\1

but with

\1

? That \1 is probably the unidentifiable character you inserted with \1.

[BTW: this question is probably better asked on the stats list]

messages.author: 7c31dd3eaed5edbe
messages.subject: Re: Problem with lookback
parts:
Maryuale, also if those numbers have more than one digit (i.e. "10" or
higher) then your search_term in gsub should have a plus sign: "/(\\d+)
\\]". Otherwise, it will only find 0-9, but not 10-99, nor 100-999,
etc. Best, Earl Brown
